title: Haram
lead: BOTIA compares the label with an international halal standard. Under this standard, this ingredient comes from a prohibited source. BOTIA does not certify food and does not issue religious rulings.
tap_hint: Tap an ingredient to see what it is
disclaimer: BOTIA reads what the label declares. Always check important information yourself.
robot_questions: Can an ingredient look neutral by its name and be haram because of its origin or processing?
What piece of information is missing when an ingredient can be halal or haram depending on its origin?
